description: This file defines a React component called TagEditModal used for editing tags within a user interface. It utilizes react-admin's useUpdate hook to handle update operations and renders a TagDialog component for user interactions.

methods.name: TagEditModal
methods.description: A React functional component that provides a modal dialog for editing tags. It handles updating tag data via the react-admin useUpdate hook and triggers callbacks on success or closure.

methods.name: handleEditTag
methods.description: Async function called when the user submits edits. It updates the tag information using react-admin's update method and calls the onSuccess callback if provided.

calls: update('tags', { id: tag.id, data, previousData: tag }, { onSuccess: async tag => { await onSuccess?.(tag); } })
<TagDialog open={open} title="Edit tag" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={handleEditTag} tag={tag} />
